BiblicalUsage: Heleph is named once, as a point on the border of Naphtali, from Heleph and Allon to Zaanannim and Adami and Nekeb and Jabneel, down to the Jordan. It marks the edge of the tribe's land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the borders of Naphtali are drawn by God with named points, and Heleph is one of them. The land is measured and the measurement is kept.
